verdict.rationale: Kimi ships an official terminal CLI (Kimi Code CLI) that runs as `kimi`, authenticates via `/login` without manual API keys, and lets the agent read code, edit files, run commands, and search the web autonomously. It also exposes an ACP protocol so editors like JetBrains and Zed can connect, and it is bundled with Kimi Membership. A community user independently corroborates its use, noting that swapping the Kimi CLI for OpenCode hurt performance. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on installation, command reference and non-interactive/scripted usage.
